observations: Photo 0 shows one used car tyre, tread face only, standing on a concrete floor.
Four circumferential grooves with angled sipes, a road (summer) style tread; grooves still visible along the whole face, wear looks moderate with scuffing on the shoulders.
No sidewall is shown, so the size, brand, load/speed index and DOT date code cannot be read.
A second tyre is partly visible at the left edge and another at top left; only one tyre is clearly offered.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'N.J. VENTURE'; small green paint mark near the bottom of the tread.
Photo is a single low resolution shot with no scale reference, so tread width cannot be measured.

claims.evidence: No sidewall in photo 0; the size marking is not visible.
Origin cannot be shown by a photo; DOT code and brand would at least show age and make.
Photo 0 centres one tyre but other tyres are in frame; quantity not stated or shown clearly.

risks.risk: Actual size differs from the claimed 295/40 R20 (a smaller, cheaper size).
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the sidewall size marking (e.g. 295/40 R20 with load and speed index).
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced as the claimed size; held until the size is read.

risks.risk: Tyre is old; rubber hardened or cracked even with tread left.
risks.proof: Close photo of the four digit DOT date code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an old, near end of life tyre.

risks.risk: Remaining tread is shallower than it looks.
risks.proof: Photo of a tread depth gauge or coin in the main groove, plus the wear indicator bar.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn close to the wear bars.

risks.risk: Sidewall cuts, bulges, plugs or inner patches.
risks.proof: Short clip rotating the tyre showing both sidewalls fully and the inside liner.

risks.risk: Brand unknown; budget brand versus premium brand changes value.
risks.proof: Sidewall photo showing the brand and tread pattern name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded budget tyre.

proof_requests: Clear close photo of the sidewall size marking (295/40 R20 and load/speed index).
Close photo of the DOT date code.
Sidewall photo showing brand and pattern name.
Tread depth gauge or coin in the main groove.
Clip turning the tyre to show both sidewalls and the inside liner.
response.reason: The tyre type is clear but its size and brand, which set the price, are not visible anywhere in photo 0 and rest only on the seller's words. A size shot is needed before even a worst case price can be set.
